source.snippet: I just released a new tool that would create your Cornell notes on any given video on YouTube. I would like to get you some feedback, give me a try on the tool and get honest reviews for me.

problem_statement: Students and knowledge workers who learn from YouTube videos lack a fast way to convert video content into structured notes (e.g. Cornell format) for study and retention, requiring manual effort or switching between tools.
target_segment: Students (university and professional certification) and self-directed learners who regularly use YouTube for educational content.
notes: Founder post showing a live tool at pelicantools.app. Signal is early-stage (3 points, 3 comments) but shows active builder/market validation attempt. Buyer context is students — willingness to pay is moderate; edtech tools in this space (e.g. Notion AI, Otter.ai) charge $8-15/mo. Weak direct buyer signal but clear recurring pain.
